relations.name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
relations.rationale: The bright acidity of preserved lemon in the couscous complements the rich, chocolatey flavor of the Dark Chocolate Rye Cookies, creating a balanced dessert and side pairing.

relations.name: Miso Butter Ramen
relations.rationale: The umami flavors of miso butter ramen provide a savory contrast to the sweet, deep chocolate cookies, making for an interesting and varied meal.
